name: library compression by repeated-subexpression search
mechanism: search a corpus of program trees for a subtree pattern with holes whose extraction as a named abstraction most reduces the total description length, add it to the library, rewrite the corpus, repeat
requires: a corpus with recurring syntactic structure
fails_when: empty on small or non-repetitive corpora (0 on the H1 split)
